desc: The Midwest Industries M-LOK Handguard for the Beretta 1301 brings precision, versatility, and durability to your tactical shotgun setup. Engineered with high-strength 6061 aluminum and featuring a rugged hard-coat anodized finish, this handguard enhances your Beretta 1301’s performance in any environment. With its slim, ergonomic design and lightweight build, the M-LOK Handguard ensures a comfortable grip and easy handling without adding bulk.
